items.source: The easiest way to give your domain classes a unique identifier is the combination of @Id and @GeneratedValue on a field of type String or Long (preferable the object, not the scalar long, as literal null is the better indicator whether an instance is new or not):

SDN provides InternalIdGenerator (the default) and UUIDStringGenerator out of the box. The latter generates new UUIDs for each entity and returns them as java.lang.String. items.source: We have been using a business key in the complete example’s MovieEntity and PersonEntity. The name of the person is assigned at construction time, both by your application and while being loaded through Spring Data.
items.translation: 我们在完整示例的 MovieEntity 和 PersonEntity 中使用了业务主键。人员的姓名在构造时即被赋值，既由您的应用程序设置，也在使用 Spring Data 加载时进行设置。

items.source: Please keep in mind that a business key is always set on the domain entity before Spring Data Neo4j processes it. This means that it cannot determine if the entity was new or not (it always assumes that the entity is new), unless also a @Version field is provided.
items.translation: 请注意，Spring Data Neo4j 在处理域实体之前，会始终为其设置业务键。这意味着它无法判断该实体是新创建的还是已存在的（除非同时提供了@Version字段），否则它将始终假设该实体是新的。

items.source: You don’t need to provide a setter for the field, SDN will use reflection to assign the field, but use a setter if there is one. If you want to create an immutable entity with an internally generated id, you have to provide a wither.
items.translation: 您无需为该字段提供 setter，SDN 将使用反射来赋值该字段，但如果存在 setter，则优先使用 setter。 如果您想创建一个具有内部生成 ID 的不可变实体，则必须提供一个wither。

items.source: You either have to provide a setter for the id attribute or something like a wither, if you want to have
items.translation: 要么必须为 id 属性提供 setter，或者类似 `wither` 的机制，如果您想要拥有

items.source: We have to discuss two separate things regarding advantages and disadvantages. The assignment itself and the UUID-Strategy. A universally unique identifier is meant to be unique for practical purposes. To quote Wikipedia: “Thus, anyone can create a UUID and use it to identify something with near certainty that the identifier does not duplicate one that has already been, or will be, created to identify something else.” Our strategy uses Java internal UUID mechanism, employing a cryptographically strong pseudo random number generator. In most cases that should work fine, but your mileage might vary.
items.translation: 我们需要就优缺点讨论两个独立的问题：任务本身以及 UUID 策略。 通用唯一标识符（UUID）旨在在实际应用中具有唯一性。 正如维基百科所述： “因此，任何人都可以创建一个 UUID，并几乎确定该标识符不会与已创建或将要创建的用于标识其他事物的标识符重复。”我们的策略采用 Java 内部的 UUID 机制，并使用密码学安全的伪随机数生成器。 在大多数情况下，这应该能正常工作，但具体情况可能因人而异。

items.source: Advantages: It is pretty clear that the id attribute is the surrogate business key, it takes no further effort or configuration to use it.
items.translation: 优势：很明显，id 属性是代理业务键，使用它无需额外努力或配置。

items.source: Disadvantage: It is tied to Neo4js internal database id, which is not unique to our application entity only over a database lifetime.
items.translation: 缺点：它依赖于 Neo4j 的内部数据库 ID，该 ID 在整个数据库生命周期内并非仅针对我们的应用实体而唯一。

items.source: Disadvantage: It takes more effort to create an immutable entity
items.translation: 缺点：创建不可变实体需要付出更多努力。

items.source: That leaves the assignment itself:
items.translation: 这便将任务本身留了下来：

items.source:
Advantage: The application is in full control and can generate a unique key that is just unique enough for the purpose of the application.
The generated value will be stable and there won’t be a need to change it later on.
items.translation: 优势：应用程序拥有完全控制权，能够生成恰好满足应用需求的唯一密钥。生成的值将保持稳定，无需后续更改。

items.source:
Disadvantage: The generated strategy is applied on the application side of things.
In those days most applications will be deployed in more than one instance to scale nicely.
If your strategy is prone to generate duplicates then inserts will fail as the uniqueness property of the primary key will be violated.
So while you don’t have to think about a unique business key in this scenario, you have to think more what to generate.
items.translation:
缺点：生成的策略是在应用层实施的。  
在那个年代，大多数应用程序会部署多个实例以实现良好的扩展性。  
如果您的策略容易生成重复项，则插入操作将会失败，因为这将违反主键的唯一性约束。  
因此，虽然在这种情况下您无需考虑唯一的业务键，但您需要更多地思考应该生成什么内容。

items.source: This is only possible, if you find a stable, unique business key, but makes great immutable domain objects.
items.translation: 这只有在找到稳定且唯一的业务键时才可行，但它能创建出优秀的不可变领域对象。

items.source:
Advantages: Using a business or natural key as primary key is natural.
The entity in question is clearly identified, and it feels most of the time just right in the further modelling of your domain.
items.translation:
优势：使用业务键或自然键作为主键是合乎自然的。  
该实体被明确标识，在后续领域建模中，它大多数情况下都显得恰到好处。

items.source:
Disadvantages: Business keys as primary keys will be hard to update once you realise that the key you found is not as stable as you thought.
Often it turns out that it can change, even when promised otherwise.
Apart from that, finding identifier that are truly unique for a thing is hard.
items.translation:
缺点：一旦您发现所选的业务键并不像预期那样稳定，将其作为主键将难以更新。  
很多时候，即使对方承诺不会变更，该键仍可能发生变化。  
此外，找到真正具有唯一性的标识符本身也是一项难题。

items.source: 1 Immutable final id field indicating a generated value 2 Public constructor, used by the application and Spring Data 3 Internally used constructor 4 This is a so-called wither for the id-attribute. It creates a new entity and set’s the field accordingly, without modifying the original entity, thus making it immutable.
items.translation: 1 表示生成值的不可变 final id 字段 2 公共构造函数，由应用程序和 Spring Data 使用 3 内部使用的构造函数 4 这是一个针对 id 属性的所谓 wither。它创建一个新的实体并相应地设置该字段，而不会修改原始实体，从而使其具有不可变性。
